svg.title: Atitlán Exchange — El pueblo en acción
svg.desc: Circular emblem with a weathered steel ring bolted at the sides. The ring reads "ATITLÁN EXCHANGE" across the top and "EL PUEBLO EN ACCIÓN" across the bottom. Inside, on parchment, an open hand with a red heart on the palm offers a glowing lightbulb, in front of a dark mechanical gear.
